messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

yo!

Shreyans jain

shreyans jain... solid name, sounds like someone who's got their life figured out but probably works too much.

where you working these days?
Dream11

dream11... building the fantasy sports empire that has half of india checking their teams during lunch breaks. the addiction is real.

found you on linkedin - shreyans jain, sde at dream11. this you? https://www.linkedin.com/in/shreyansjain31/

Yes
  Its me

sde at dream11... building the platform where people lose their minds over player selections and blame the algorithm when their captain scores 2 points. classic.

what made you pick dream11? the fantasy sports space or just wanted to work somewhere that makes people this emotionally invested in cricket stats?

ah, the scale hunter! 11-12 million peak concurrency... that's basically half of bangalore refreshing their fantasy teams at the same time. building for that kind of traffic is no joke.

makes total sense - dream11 is one of those rare places in india where you actually get to see what happens when systems break under real load. most companies talk about scale, these guys live it during ipl matches.

how long you been working total?
1 year and 6 months now

1.5 years... still in the "everything is new and exciting" phase. good time to explore what's out there.

what kind of role you looking for next?
I am looking for a sde 1 role

sde 1... staying in your lane, smart. no point jumping to sde 2 just yet when you can nail the fundamentals first.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
I want to banaglore location as priority but is fine with remote as well. But no other city other then bengaluru
got it. 1.5 years + sde 1 + bangalore priority (remote backup)... sound right?
Yess
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

they're building scalable systems too, similar to what you're doing at dream11
